items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I played there twice. Once with Benny Goodman and Buddy Rich and Milt Hinton, Hank Jones.

ctx.x: You played at the White House a number of times?
I played there twice. Once with Benny Goodman and Buddy Rich and Milt Hinton, Hank Jones.

items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: And it was with Reagan first with Sinatra and with Benny Goodman, Buddy Rich playing drums, Milt Hinton, Hank Jones on piano.

ctx.x: Well we played for the president, a couple of presidents. And it was with Reagan first with Sinatra and with Benny Goodman, Buddy Rich playing drums, Milt Hinton, Hank Jones on piano. And then another one was with —
